# Curater

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 23 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Visual-curation community surfaces: ABCDiatype over a #fff/#f2f2f2 field, a 48px icon rail whose active page fills #f2f2f2, white 9999px pill buttons that fill #f2f2f2 and sink 2px on press, the 9-hue --Curater-selection-* tag palette, 24px-radius media cards, a collapsible 170px search field, the TasteScope WebGL globe teaser and public /feed /curation/<id> /profile grids.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; creating curations, the TasteScope questionnaire, saving items and settings sit behind 'Log in or sign up' / the Google SSO button and were never reached; nothing was submitted and no account created). Themes: light.

Curater's public signed-out surface — the trending home, the /feed themes-and-curations grid, the /taste TasteScope teaser, a /curation/<id> detail, a /ravi profile and /terms — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and feed at 390 x 844. Curater is a platform for curating and discovering taste (a visual-curation community); the signed-in app behind 'Log in or sign up' was never entered, and nothing was submitted.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
